recentItems.title: Can a Puppy Break Kiell Smith-Bynoe’s Concentration? - BBC
recentItems.description:
Kiell Smith-Bynoe and Tolu Ogunmefun face off in a battle of concentration.

Kiell tries to stay focused on Ghosts and The Weakest Link, but Tolu may have found the ultimate distraction: an irresistibly cute puppy. Later, Tolu attempts to watch Man Like Mobeen and Luther while Kiell fights back with workouts, bizarre noises and a relentless distraction campaign.

Can either of them keep their eyes on the screen?

00:54 Round 1 - Doggy Daycare
05:13 Round 2 - Mind-numbing co-worker
08:45 Round 3 - Birthday beats
11:17 Round 4 - The personal trainer

Just Keep Watching is the celebrity challenge series where one contestant watches TV while the other does everything possible to break their concentration. The player who watches for the longest wins.
